title: Local computers
description: Connect your computer to work in its local codespaces.
actionFailed: The operation failed. Refresh the computer and try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
enrollmentTitle: Complete the connection on your computer
tokenHint: Run the command on your computer and paste this one-time token when requested. It is shown only here and expires at {{expires}}.
confirmHint: After approval on your computer, refresh this list, review its permissions and confirm the connection here.
expired: This pairing has expired. Start a new connection.
confirmDescription: Allow {{label}} to serve the repositories and limits shown below for your account.
revokeDescription: Disconnect {{label}} and block further agent work on it. The computer's local files are not deleted.
limits: Per new codespace: {{cpu}} CPU · {{memory}} GiB memory. Shared storage on this computer: {{storage}} GiB.
disabled: Agent access is disabled on this computer
resourcesDescription: Create and manage GitHub Codespaces or local codespaces on your computers.
createHint: Each codespace has its own working environment. Resource defaults and permission expiry are set in the computer settings.
connectionRequired: Connect and confirm a local computer with approved repositories.
unavailable: Local work is unavailable. Check the computer's agent access, permission expiry and connection, then refresh.
localDisclosure: Agents work in separate codespaces on your computer with the access you approved. Settings stay pending until the computer applies them. Disconnecting here does not delete local files.

codespaces.title: Codespaces on this computer
codespaces.description: Each codespace is a separate working environment. You can create several for the same repository.
codespaces.loadFailed: Could not load this computer's codespaces.
codespaces.accessDisabled: Agent access is unavailable. Check the computer's connection, access switch and permission expiry.
codespaces.notObserved: State has not been confirmed yet
codespaces.resourcesStale: The computer could not confirm every codespace. The last confirmed states are kept; check again.

errors.CODESPACE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The computer could not confirm the codespace state. Check its connection and try again.
errors.CODESPACE_PROVIDER_DISABLED: Codespace work is disabled. Check the computer's access settings.
errors.CODESPACE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: Access to this codespace is no longer approved. Check the computer's repository permissions.

agent.title: Agent repository access
agent.hint: Optionally let an agent add existing private repositories or create new private repositories in your connected personal GitHub account. Choose each permission separately. This request takes effect only after the computer confirms it.
agent.accountRequired: Connect GitHub and refresh its connection before granting agent repository access.
agent.disabled: Applied permission: agent repository additions are disabled.
agent.applied: Applied permission: {{owner}}; existing private {{existing}}; new private {{created}}; push {{push}}.
agent.allowNewPrivate: Create and add new private repositories
agent.revokeHint: Disabling this permission blocks new additions after confirmation. Existing repository permissions and files remain available.

editor.title: Settings for {{label}}
editor.optIn: Enable settings management on this computer with npm run local -- web-control --confirm --max-lease-hours 168. Use the same --state as your connection. Existing permissions and files are preserved.
editor.requestHint: The computer applies saved settings. Until then, the current permissions above remain in effect. Offline computers keep the request pending.
editor.futureProfile: CPU, RAM and Docker storage defaults apply to new codespaces. Existing codespaces keep these resources. Shared storage capacity applies to all local codespaces on this computer.
editor.authorHint: Leave both fields empty to use your verified GitHub identity when available. Your computer's Git configuration is not copied.

states.pending: Requested revision {{requested}}; applied revision {{applied}}. Waiting for the computer.
states.rejected: Revision {{requested}} was rejected; revision {{applied}} remains applied.

editor.invalid: Check the values, repository names and Git identity. Limits must fit the locally approved ceiling and the work lease must be finite, no more than seven days.
editor.label: Computer name
editor.enabled: Allow agents to work with local codespaces
editor.leaseCeiling: Locally approved maximum: {{hours}} hours. This does not renew automatically.
editor.storageBytes: Shared local codespace storage on this computer (GiB)
